reasons: effect_mismatch:Block bulk mutation until each repository's authoritative source and projection model are established.

observed.effect: Block bulk mutation until each repository's authoritative source and projection model are established.
observed.modifier: three repositories with uncertain source ownership
observed.response: 不能按文件名盲目批改。先为三个仓库分别建立 owner map：候选 source、generated mirrors、治理记录、生成命令和仓库级约束；以生成配置、治理记录和 source/runtime contract 为证据分类。随后给出逐仓 preview，只有确认属于 source 的 `skills/<name>/` 才进入改写；mirror 只通过各仓库声明的生成流程更新。若任一仓库仍有多个可信 source，暂停该仓库并请求一次明确选择，其他已确认仓库可独立继续。
observed.route_decision: Perform read-only source-owner discovery and preview first; mutate only unambiguous source owners.
observed.source_owner_assumption: Unknown per repository; same name and path shape are insufficient evidence of common ownership.
would_modify_paths: each confirmed repository's governance/tests/docs as required
generated mirrors only through each repository's projector
would_run_commands: rg --files across each repository to locate skill, governance, generation, and project-instruction files
repository-specific focused validation after ownership is confirmed
git diff --check in each modified repository
